faq.title: The questions we get asked
faq.subtitle: For the others, the first 30-minute call is made for that.
faq.q1: Is NBHC an agency or a software publisher?
faq.a1: Both. We develop our own products: Devizly, already live, and Vlogyz, not open yet. And we build custom tools for companies. What we learn on the former serves the latter.
faq.q2: What is a custom tool, concretely?
faq.a2: Software built around your rules: your prices, your special cases, your way of preparing a quote or an invoice. It builds on your existing data and your advisors keep control of every decision.
faq.a3: The first 30-minute call is free. After that, scope and price are written down before we start: you know what will be built and what you will pay.
faq.q4: Who owns the tool once delivered?
faq.a4: You do. What we build for you belongs to you, and you keep it if the collaboration ends.
faq.q5: What if a tool is not the right answer?
faq.a5: We tell you during the first call. A well-kept spreadsheet or off-the-shelf software is sometimes enough, and in that case we build nothing.
